# Nodality

> A JavaScript UI library. You describe a page as two plain arrays — `elements`
> (what to render) and `nodes` (how it looks and behaves) — and pass them to a
> `Des` instance, which builds the DOM.

Elements take `text`, not `value`. `value` means something else: a keyframe
value, or the name of an animated property.

## api

- [Button](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/button): `button.js`
- [Center](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/center): `center.js`
- [FlexGrid](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/flexgrid): `flex-grid.js`
- [FlexRow](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/flexrow): `flex-row.js`
- [Image](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/image): `image.js`
- [Link](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/link): `link.js`
- [Picker](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/picker): `picker.js`
- [Text](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/text): `text.js`
- [TextField](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/textfield): `text-field.js`
- [UList](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/ulist): `ulist.js`
- [Wrapper](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/api/wrapper): `container.js`

## basics

- [Basics](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/basics/README): This library employs an unique approach to building static websites using declarative UI components and nodes that will style them.
- [Animation](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/basics/animation): Create striking animations using JS responsive API.
- [CDN](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/basics/cdn): To use Nodality with CDN, use this code:
- [Custom elements](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/basics/customElements): To create a custom element using Nodality library, you extend the  class.
- [Designer](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/basics/designer): Designer instance accepts nodes and elements arrays.
- [Nodes](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/basics/nodes): Nodes allow you to simply you to modify the elements.
- [Getting started](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/basics/start): This library works with *elements* represented as an array of HTML entities, and *nodes* that control the behavior of elements.

## raster

- [Raster basics](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/raster/basics): Raster ops run your element through a WebGL shader.
- [Composing a pipeline](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/raster/composition): A chain is not a list of passes.
- [Raster ops](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/raster/ops): Every node has an `op` and a set of options.

- [ScrollVideo](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/scrollanimation/scrollvideo): Play video as you scroll.
- [Together](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/scrollanimation/together): Here is how you can combine the elements using the  element.
- [TransformAnimation](https://nodalityjs.github.io/docs/scrollanimation/transformanimation): Transform element as you scroll down.
